hypothesis: First real native-8.0.0 candidate after square-indexing fix. Train on full 10M Lc0 test91 Q-targets (lc0q10m.bullet) for multiple epochs. Baseline architecture (16×12 input, 1536 hidden, 1 output bucket). Goal: establish native-8.0.0 lineage with verified training pipeline, target neutral-to-positive vs default.net.

changed_variables.architecture: 16×12 input buckets, 1536 hidden, 1 output bucket (matches existing engine/tooling)

stages.name: train
stages.why: Train on full 10M lc0q10m for 10 epochs. At ~76 superbatches/epoch, 760 total = 10 epochs. RTX 5090: ~1.2M pos/sec → ~10 min total. Standard lr schedule 1e-3 → 1e-4.

stages.name: export_and_copy
stages.why: Copy final checkpoint to assets as candidate net

stages.name: smoke_test
stages.why: Sanity check: load net and eval test position. Should return reasonable score (not broken).

stages.name: sprt_256_game_smoke
stages.why: 256-game smoke test vs default.net. Per memory: run smoke (256 games) before any longer SPRT. Gate: LOS > 20% to proceed to full SPRT. If LOS < 20%, candidate is likely regressive.

stages.name: sprt_1k_main
stages.why: Full 1k-game SPRT if smoke passes. H0: Elo ≤ -5, H1: Elo ≥ +5. Accept if neutral-to-positive, gives starting point for native-8.0.0 lineage.

gates: training completes (~10 min) and exports quantised.bin
smoke_test evalnet returns reasonable score (proves net is loadable and sane)
256-game smoke: LOS > 20% (if not, reject and iterate)
1k SPRT: if accepted (Elo ≥ -5), native-8.0.0-rc1 becomes native-8.0.0 baseline
if rejected at 1k SPRT (Elo < -5), document and start iteration 2 with different hyperparams
notes: This is the first native-8.0.0 candidate with verified square indexing.
Deliberately conservative: baseline arch, standard lr, Q-targets only.
If this passes, future iterations can explore: more epochs, pairwise training, architecture changes.
RTX 5090 training speed: ~1.2M pos/sec for 1536-hidden → 10M×10 epochs in ~10 min.
